question: Should Flydubai keep flying to Israel, yes or no?

lines.text: A Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv has been diverted to Tabuk in Saudi Arabia, after a reported fight in the cockpit.
Flight FZ1073, a Boeing 737, sent out an emergency signal over Jordan.
Tracking data shows it dropped from thirty-three thousand feet to seventeen thousand in about a minute, then levelled out.
Passengers say they heard shouting from the front of the plane as it dipped.
Israeli officials say the co-pilot is believed to have attacked the captain with a knife.
Flydubai has not confirmed that account.
The plane turned south and landed safely in Tabuk at 9:45 in the morning.
Tabuk airport says the captain and co-pilot were injured and taken to hospital.
Flydubai says all passengers are safe and accounted for.

scene.quote: all passengers are safe and accounted for

lines.text: Israel scrambled fighter jets while the alert was active.
Its security services are investigating whether it was deliberate.
Israel's transport minister wants Flydubai flights to Israel suspended, Hebrew media report.
